label: Contemporary R&B / Mandopop with Electronic influences

cards.mood: The piece opens with an intimate, breathless atmosphere that establishes a sense of romantic longing.
cards.palette: A warm, electric piano serves as the core harmonic instrument, playing sustained chords and delicate arpeggios from the Intro through to the Outro, anchoring the song's emotional tonality.
